transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I've been waking up feeling really sad and hollow. It's like the studio lights are on, but there's no music in me anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About nine months now. It’s been there pretty consistently.
Have you ever had times in your life where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, hyperactive, or like you didn't need much sleep?
Yes. There were stretches when I felt dazzlingly alive, like everything was possible. But I’d get suddenly furious if anyone questioned my plans or reminded me that my ankle still needed rest.
When you had those periods of high energy, how long did they usually last?
It started after my ankle injury, and this whole pattern has been going on for about two months now.
During those high-energy periods, did things ever get so intense that you had serious trouble managing your daily responsibilities or needed to be hospitalized?

I wasn’t hospitalized, but it did interfere with things. I fell behind on teaching prep and missed a grant deadline. My studio got pretty chaotic, and collaborators had to take over basic scheduling. I still showed up for the essential stuff, but I wasn’t functioning the way I normally do as a choreographer or teacher.
